long_window_secs.description: Long-window (slow scan) tier window. Default 21600 (6 h).

long_threshold.description: Distinct ports within long_window_secs to ban (detector name port_scan_slow). 0 disables the tier. Default 25.

long_ban_duration_secs.description: Ban duration of the long-window tier. Default 604800 (7 days).

max_tracked_ips.description: Cap of IPs tracked per tier (memory bound). Default 50000.
